examples.arabic: ضحكت وقلت هلا عندي كنزة كبيرة وقطعة من التاريخ
examples.english: I laughed and said now I have a big sweater and a piece of history
examples.transliteration: Dehekt w qolt hala'a 'andi kanzeh kbeereh w qit'a men et tareekh

examples.arabic: لارا، بتعرفي ليش التاريخ مادة صعبة؟
examples.english: Lara, do you know why history is a difficult subject?
examples.transliteration: Lara, bti'rifi lesh at-taarikh maaddeh sa'beh?

examples.english: God willing, it will help us with the difficult history project.
examples.storyTitle: An Old Map in Souq al-Hamidiyyeh

examples.arabic: ردت ليلى بخجل: أهلاً نور، عم بحضر لامتحان التاريخ بكرا.
examples.english: Layla replied shyly: Hello Noor, I'm preparing for the history exam tomorrow.
examples.transliteration: Raddat Layla bi-khajal: Ahlan Noor, 'am bahedder la-imtihan at-taarikh bokra.
